u0: The agent is making ordinary progress toward the exit and has no pending siren response; either the siren is not ringing or a switch toggle has just dealt with it. The required goal remains to step onto the exit. If the siren starts and no toggle is made, progress shifts to an outstanding alarm response; after that response is handled, the agent returns to this ordinary progress.
u1: An alarm has started and the switch has not yet been toggled, so the preferred response is now pending. The agent should go to the switch and toggle it, which clears this pending response and returns to ordinary progress toward the exit; the siren may later start again. The required exit goal still remains, and the agent can alternatively continue to the exit while the siren is still ringing, which completes the task but leaves the siren preference unmet.
u2: The agent has reached the exit, so the required goal has been satisfied and the task is successfully complete. The siren preference may have been fully handled or left unmet depending on whether the alarm was still ringing unanswered at the exit; either way, reaching the exit ends the episode. No further objective remains.
